parameters.name: DataVersion
parameters.description: The full Network Data Version the Node currently uses.

parameters.name: LeaderRouterID
parameters.description: The 8-bit {{param}} the Node attempts to utilize upon becoming a router or leader on the Thread network.

parameters.name: PartitionID
parameters.description: The Thread Leader Partition ID for the Thread network to which the Node is joined.

parameters.name: StableDataVersion
parameters.description: The Network Data Version for the stable subset of data the Node currently uses.

parameters.name: Weighting
parameters.description: The Thread Leader weight used when operating in the Leader role.
